note: P4136 (Pro 20:13) — love not sleep, lest you come to poverty; open your eyes and have plenty. (saba 'plenty' = standalone.)

dims.v: love-of-ease — loving sleep, which leads to poverty
the love of sleep/ease that, indulged, brings a man to poverty
(the wakeful diligence that brings plenty, by contrast)
the ease the sluggard loves, set against wakeful labour

aheb (love) NEGATED — 'LOVE not sleep, lest you come to poverty'; the love of ease and sleep impoverishes. Diligence ('open your eyes') brings bread. The heart's affections decide the outcome — love of sleep or love of work.
